units.source_text: 夫人原是信州地狱谷温泉旅馆的女儿。

en.t: The master's wife was originally the daughter of an innkeeper at the Jigokudani hot spring in Shinshu.

units.source_text: 大竹七段和吴清源在地狱谷旅馆深居简出研究新布局这段故事，在围棋界是众所周知。

en.t: In the Go world, everyone knew the story of how Otake 7-dan and Go Seigen secluded themselves at the Jigokudani inn and studied the new opening strategy.

units.source_text: 我早已听说夫人姑娘时代就是个美人。

en.t: I had long heard that the master's wife had been a beauty even in her girlhood.

units.source_text: 一些年轻诗人从志贺高原来到地狱谷，都说夫人的姐妹们很艳美。

en.t: Some young poets who came from the Shiga Highlands to Jigokudani all said that the master's wife's sisters were strikingly beautiful.

units.source_text: 我这个印象，是从诗人那里得来的。

en.t: That impression of mine came from the poets.
